about: Check-in chat replies for check-society-suggestions.mjs. Regenerate with --refresh rather than edit.

gigs, rules out sport.message: Gigs and live music. Not sport. A gig, then out with mates. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
gigs, rules out sport.reply: If you are into live music and nights out, you might enjoy [[Music]], [[Rock]], or [[Vocaloid]]. You can also check out [[Gigs]] and [[Events]] for live music and things to do with mates.

homebody, rules out partying.message: Board games and reading. Not partying. A quiet night in with a film. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
homebody, rules out partying.reply: For film lovers, [[Film]] is a great choice to chat about movies, and [[Book]] fits right in if you enjoy reading. You might also like [[Gaming and Roleplay]] for board games and tabletop sessions.

sporty early riser.message: Football and the gym. Up early for a run, then football. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
sporty early riser.reply:
Since you are into football and running, you might like [[Cycling]] for getting outdoors, or [[Climbing]] to mix up your fitness routine. 

For football itself, you can also check out the [[Football]] club for team training and matches.

lie-in and the cinema.message: Photography and the cinema. A lie-in, then the cinema. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
lie-in and the cinema.reply: For the cinema, you might like [[Film]] to watch and chat about movies. What kind of films or cameras are you into so I can suggest a photography one too?

gamer, last minute (near tie).message: Gaming, Minecraft and FIFA. Gaming online late with mates. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
gamer, last minute (near tie).reply: For gaming and online matches, you might like [[Gaming and Roleplay]] and [[Esports]]. What kind of games do you usually play with your mates?

clubbing (synonyms for partying).message: Going clubbing and festivals. Big nights out. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
clubbing (synonyms for partying).reply: If you are into big nights out and live music, take a look at the [[Events]] and [[Gigs]] pages.

outdoors, rules out the gym.message: Hiking and climbing. Not the gym. Up early for a long walk. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
outdoors, rules out the gym.reply: For hiking and long walks, [[Walking]] is a great society to join, and [[Climbing]] fits your interest in climbing too. You could also take a look at [[Mountaineering]] for more outdoor adventures.

unrelated to every mentor.message: Knitting and birdwatching. A trip to a nature reserve. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
unrelated to every mentor.reply: For knitting, you might like [[Stitch, Make & Bitch]] to meet others who enjoy crafts. What kind of birds do you like to watch, or are you just getting started?

only says what they don't want in 3 answ.message: I'm not into sport, clubbing or gaming. I don't like loud nights out. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
only says what they don't want in 3 answ.reply: Thanks for letting me know what you'd rather skip. What sort of hobbies or creative interests do you enjoy so I can suggest a few societies that fit you?

quiet nights in, not nights out (opposit.message: Reading and films. Quiet nights in, not nights out. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
quiet nights in, not nights out (opposit.reply: For quiet nights in, [[Book]] and [[Film]] are great choices for catching up with others over shared interests. You can also take a look at [[Societies]] to browse the full range available.

live music (synonym for gigs).message: Live music, mostly indie bands. Seeing a band, then drinks with friends. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
live music (synonym for gigs).reply: For live music and indie bands, you might enjoy the [[Music]] society.

interested in Ukrainian culture, not Ukr.message: I'm not Ukrainian, but I'd love to learn more about Ukrainian culture and meet people. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
interested in Ukrainian culture, not Ukr.reply: You would love [[Ukrainian]], which welcomes anyone interested in the community and culture. Have a look at [[Societies]] to browse other groups you might enjoy too.

a mature student.message: I'm a mature student, so I'm a bit older than most people on my course. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
a mature student.reply:
Being a mature student is quite common, and the [[Mature Students]] society is a great place to meet others in the same boat. 

What kind of things do you usually enjoy doing in your spare time?

worried about money.message: I'm really worried about money. My loan won't last until the end of term and I don't know what to do.
worried about money.reply: It is completely understandable to feel worried about money, but there is support available to help you through this. You can check [[Cost of Living]] for money help in one place, or take a look at [[Food Pantry]] if you need a little extra help with groceries.

run out of money for food.message: I've run out of money for food this week and I'm not sure what to do.
run out of money for food.reply: I am really sorry to hear you are dealing with that right now, but there is support available. You can look at [[Cost of Living]] and [[Food Pantry]] for help with food and money worries.

accused of plagiarism.message: I've been accused of plagiarism in one of my essays and I'm panicking.
accused of plagiarism.reply: Try not to panic, as help is available. You can get guidance and support from the [[Advice Centre]] to help you through this situation.

landlord won't fix the damp.message: My landlord won't fix the damp in my flat and keeps ignoring my messages. Can I complain?
landlord won't fix the damp.reply:
That sounds really frustrating and you definitely should not have to deal with that. 

The [[Advice Centre]] can help you with housing issues, including how to deal with your landlord. You can also use [[Rate Your Landlord]] to check or leave reviews for student housing in Newcastle.

swims a lot.message: I swim a lot and I'd like to keep it up while I'm here. Any clubs or societies?
swims a lot.reply: You can join [[Swimming]] to keep up with your swimming and train or compete. Have a look at their card for details on training times and memberships.

played football at school.message: I played football at school and I'd like to start playing again. Where should I look?
played football at school.reply: For football, you should take a look at the [[Football]] club run by Northumbria Sport. Their card has all the details on memberships, prices and training times.

into ice hockey.message: I'm really into ice hockey. Is there anything for me here?
into ice hockey.reply: You will find [[Ice Hockey]] is a great society to join and meet people who share your passion.

never done sport, wants to get fit.message: I've never really done any sport, but I want to get fitter this year. Any ideas?
never done sport, wants to get fit.reply: If you are looking to get fitter, you might enjoy [[Pilates]] or [[Yoga]] for staying active at your own pace. What kind of activities usually catch your eye?

how to contact a suggested society.first: I love knitting and crochet. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
how to contact a suggested society.firstReply: Check out [[Hooked By Crochet]] for people who share your passion.
how to contact a suggested society.thenReply: You can find all the details and contact options for [[Hooked By Crochet]].

how to join a suggested society.first: I'm really into climbing and bouldering. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
how to join a suggested society.firstReply:
If you love climbing, you might enjoy [[Climbing]] or [[Outdoor Climbing]].
Northumbria Sport also runs [[Climbing]] as a club, so you can check their page for training times and memberships.
how to join a suggested society.thenReply: For the societies, you can check [[Climbing]] or [[Outdoor Climbing]] again to find out how to join and get in touch. For the sport club, take a look at the [[Climbing]] club card for details on memberships and how to book.

what a suggested society is like.first: I like board games and tabletop role-playing games. Are there any societies for that?
what a suggested society is like.firstReply: Yes, we have [[Gaming and Roleplay]] for board games and roleplaying, which should fit what you enjoy. Have a look at the [[Societies]] page to see how to join.
what a suggested society is like.thenReply: If you want to know what it is like, have a look at [[Gaming and Roleplay]] to see the details and find out how to get in touch.

a suggested society's Instagram.first: I love films and going to the cinema. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
a suggested society's Instagram.firstReply:
For films and cinema, you might enjoy [[Film]] or [[Film & TV Production]]. 

What kind of movies do you usually enjoy watching?
a suggested society's Instagram.thenReply: You can check [[Film]] to see their social links and find out how to get in touch.
